page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.re6p-redis.large is a virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.re6p family, running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor based on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, providing a memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU.

This instance configuration does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 1 Gbps and does not include any GPU accelerators or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation and balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.re6p-redis.large is designed for workloads requiring consistent compute performance without resource sharing. It is qualitatively positioned as a cost-efficient entry-level option for lightweight database caching, Redis deployments, and general-purpose application hosting that do not demand high local disk I/O or massive parallel processing.
